content.title: Where to watch the Houston Rockets vs. Los Angeles Lakers NBA playoffs Game 1 for free tonight
content.text: Watch Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic (77) look to score against Houston Rockets guard Amen Thompson (1) on Wednesday, March 18 when they play their third and final regular season game. (AP Photo/David J. Phillip)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe Los Angeles Lakers and the Houston Rockets will begin their first-round Western Conference playoff series tonight at Crypto.com Arena. Fans can catch Game 1 of the series at 8:30 p.m. ET, with streaming options available through Fubo, DirecTV Stream and ESPN Unlimited. New customers can score free trials and first-month discounts through Fubo and DirecTV Stream. Lakers vs. Rockets Streaming OptionsFubo: ABC is one of 211 channels available through Fubo’s Pro plan, which costs $73.99 per month. Other channels include CBS, Fox and ESPN. New customers can start with a free trial of up to five days and score $25 off the first month. DirecTV Stream: Over 125 channels are included in DirecTV Stream’s Choice plan, including ABC, Fox, CBS, NBC and ESPN. New subscribers can snag a five-day free trial and take $35 off the first month of their subscription. ESPN Unlimited: ESPN’s streaming service includes access to games on ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ABC and more.
